map.血尿来源鉴别：畸形红细胞为主为肾小球性（IgA 肾病等），均一红细胞为外科性（结: Hematuria source differentiation: predominantly dysmorphic RBCs indicate a glomerular origin (IgA nephropathy and others), uniform RBCs indicate a surgical cause (stones/tumor/infection); a mixed picture with dysmorphic cells not below 70% is classified as glomerular. Total-stream hematuria suggests bladder or above, initial hematuria suggests the urethra, terminal hematuria suggests the bladder neck/prostate.
map.血尿来源鉴别要点: Key points for differentiating hematuria source
map.无痛性全程肉眼血尿须首先排除泌尿系恶性肿瘤（膀胱癌、肾癌、肾盂癌），尤其是中老年: Painless total-stream gross hematuria must first exclude urologic malignancy (bladder cancer, renal cancer, renal pelvic cancer), especially in middle-aged and elderly smokers; ultrasound or CT urography plus cystoscopy should be performed.
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供鉴别参考，血尿病因诊断需结合影像学、内镜、病理等综合判断。: ⚠️ This tool is for differential reference only; the etiologic diagnosis of hematuria requires imaging, endoscopy and pathology in combination.
map.RBC 异形率 80%≥70% 支持肾小球性（IgA 肾病/肾炎）；无血块、伴蛋: A dysmorphic RBC rate of 80% (>=70%) supports a glomerular origin (IgA nephropathy/nephritis); absence of clots together with proteinuria adds further support.
map.均一型 RBC 支持非肾小球性（结石/肿瘤/感染），需影像加膀胱镜排查尿路病变。: Uniform RBCs support a non-glomerular source (stones/tumor/infection); imaging plus cystoscopy is needed to screen for urinary tract lesions.
map.异形 RBC（多形型）源于肾小球基底膜挤压，均一型源于下尿路，是定位关键。: Dysmorphic RBCs (polymorphic type) arise from being squeezed through the glomerular basement membrane, while uniform RBCs come from the lower urinary tract; this is the key to localization.
map.血尿出现的时相有什么用？: What is the use of hematuria timing?
map.初始血尿提示前尿道病变，终末血尿提示膀胱颈、后尿道或前列腺部，全程血尿提示膀胱及: Initial hematuria suggests an anterior urethral lesion, terminal hematuria suggests the bladder neck, posterior urethra or prostatic portion, and total-stream hematuria suggests a source at or above the bladder (kidney or ureter). Combining RBC morphology (dysmorphic vs uniform) and the presence of clots narrows the location further.
